why: The quote is genuine but the finding is a double duplicate, and its cited mechanism is the wrong line. (1) VERBATIM: curl of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-connect.md puts the sentence at line 381 as a bullet, byte-identical: '* It disables auto-updates, so plan for another update path, such as your package manager or managed distribution.' Whole line read; the second half does not reverse it, it prescribes managed distribution as the substitute. Context :361-:386 confirms the framing (nonessential traffic 'to Anthropic and to third-party services such as GitHub: version checks, telemetry, error reports, release notes'). So the finding is not refuted on the quote. (2) CITED LINES: apps/electron/src/main/auto-update.ts:127 is 'autoUpdater.autoDownload = true' and :130 is 'autoUpdater.autoInstallOnAppQuit = true', both module-level and unconditional, and 'grep -ain' over that file finds no env/config gate (its only process.env read is LOCALAPPDATA at :47). Literally correct. BUT :127 is a dead default and cannot be the mechanism: checkForUpdates() saves previousAutoDownload (:333), overwrites autoUpdater.autoDownload with the option (:334) and restores it in finally (:369), and all four production call sites pass an explicit {autoDownload: true} (auto-update.ts:448, menu.ts:75, menu.ts:200, handlers/system.ts:274). Flipping :127 would change nothing. Only :130 is genuinely unconditional. (3) LAYER UP, consequence checked separately from the identifier: 'the app still probes ... every launch' is true only for packaged builds. The launch probe is apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:1259-1262, gated on 'if (app.isPackaged)' with an else branch logging 'Skipping auto-update in dev mode'. A grep confined to auto-update.ts cannot see that gate, which is exactly inert-worklist section 4 shape 3 (enforcement one layer up). LAYER DOWN: the feed is not an Anthropic or third-party host. electron-builder.yml:77-80 sets provider generic with url ${env.NESSY_DESKTOP_UPDATE_URL} and channel ${env.NESSY_DESKTOP_UPDATE_CHANNEL}, baked into app-update.yml at build time; .gitlab-ci.yml:234-235 fills them from the org's own $NESSY_DESKTOP_DEV_UPDATE_URL. That is the organisation's managed distribution, i.e. the very alternative the quoted sentence recommends, so the hazard the page names (blocked egress to Anthropic/GitHub) does not map onto this subsystem. Also a sibling-subsystem mismatch: the doc governs the Claude Code CLI's self-update via npm/native installer, ours is electron-updater swapping an app bundle. (4) ALREADY REGISTERED, twice. The page-contract half is admitted by the finding itself: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:319 records that CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC has no reader anywhere ('grep -rain DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC' over the repo, excluding node_modules/.git/dist, returns only doc files - zero source readers, confirmed). The supposedly novel half is f204 on the 'setup' page, in this same sweep: same file, same lines 127 and 130, same evidence shape, same consequence ('Neither flag, nor a Nessy-prefixed equivalent, is read. Auto-download and install-on-quit are hardcoded on ... A corporate deployment cannot pin users to a distributed version'), and f202 covers autoUpdatesChannel at :127. That is the correct home: the updater kill switches are documented on env-vars.md:367 (DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER), :387 (DISABLE_UPDATES) and settings.md:240 (autoUpdatesChannel), not on llm-gateway-connect, whose only contract is the conditional effect of a variable already on the register. Registering it here triple-counts one gap. (5) NOT one of the nine inert-worklist section 3 owner decisions (checked: seatbelt wildcard, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions). Managed policy carries requiredMinimumVersion/requiredMaximumVersion (managed-policy.ts:386-398) but no update kill switch, so the gap is real - it is just already booked elsewhere and mis-attributed here.
correctedState: Against THIS page the only divergence is the one already on the books: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC has no reader in this fork (deviation-register:319). The broader 'no off switch for the updater' state is real but belongs to the setup/env-vars pages, where it is already filed as f204 (DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER / DISABLE_UPDATES) and f202 (autoUpdatesChannel) against the same two lines. Its wording also needs two corrections: auto-update.ts:127 is a dead default, overwritten at :334 and restored at :369 on every check while all four call sites pass an explicit {autoDownload: true} (auto-update.ts:448, menu.ts:75, menu.ts:200, handlers/system.ts:274), so the operative unconditional assignment is only :130 and the actual launch probe is index.ts:1259-1262, gated on app.isPackaged - dev builds do not probe. And the feed is not 'the S3 feed' in the doc's sense: electron-builder.yml:77-80 injects a generic-provider URL from NESSY_DESKTOP_UPDATE_URL at build time (.gitlab-ci.yml:234-235), i.e. the deploying organisation's own managed distribution, which is the substitute the quoted sentence prescribes rather than the Anthropic/third-party traffic it warns about.
